name: Large-title Header
hint: Scroll slowly: the big title flies off the artwork and docks in the bar. Pull down to stretch the art.
description: The iOS large-title navigation bar for React Native, over hero artwork on a playlist screen. The large title doesn't fade and swap: it flies from the artwork into the nav bar, shrinking, sliding to the centre and turning from white to the bar's ink, and docks with a light haptic tick as the bar frosts in and gains its hairline. Pulling down stretches the artwork from its top edge; scrolling parallaxes it away and darkens it. Glass buttons over the art cross-fade into plain bar buttons with a back label, and the filter row sticks under the bar. A collapsing header scrubbed by scroll on the UI thread.
intents: collapsing header on scroll in react native
big title that shrinks into the nav bar
stretchy hero header over album artwork
usage: Use at the top level of a stack or on a detail screen with a strong image (album, place, profile). Deeper screens use the small title only. Keep titles to one or two words so the large title fits on one line; swap <Art> for your own image.
